definitions.explanation: A system that cools the air in a room or building.

examples.japanese: {冷房|れいぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}してください→消す：00528_kesu⟧。
examples.english: Please turn off the air conditioning.

examples.japanese: {冷房|れいぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけてください→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Please turn on the air conditioning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷房|れいぼう}なしでは⟦{過|す}ごせない→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I can't get through summer without air conditioning.

examples.japanese: {冷房|れいぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げてもらえますか→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: Could you raise the air conditioning temperature?

examples.japanese: {冷房|れいぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}きすぎて→効く：01932_kiku⟧⟦{寒|さむ}くなった→寒い：00664_samui⟧ので、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げた→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: The air conditioning got too cold, so I raised the temperature a bit.

notes:
{冷房|れいぼう} specifically refers to cooling/air conditioning, as opposed to heating. The word combines {冷|れい} (cold) + {房|ぼう} (room/chamber).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷房|れいぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to turn on AC
- {冷房|れいぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to turn off AC
- {冷房|れいぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧: AC works well / is effective
- {冷房|れいぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}きすぎる→効く：01932_kiku⟧: AC is too strong/cold
- {冷房|れいぼう}⟦{完備|かんび}→完備：16692_kanbi⟧: fully air-conditioned

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧: air conditioner (the device, covers both cooling and heating)
- ⟦クーラー→クーラー：01352_kuuraa⟧: cooler, AC unit (slightly dated term)
- ⟦{空調|くうちょう}→空調：27362_kuuchou⟧: climate control (formal/technical)
- ⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧: heating (the opposite of {冷房|れいぼう})

USAGE:
In summer, {冷房|れいぼう}⟦{病|びょう}→病：13610_yamai⟧ (air conditioning sickness) from excessive cold is a common topic in Japan.
